preContext.title: The Living Ledger
preContext.body: CITIXEN OS replaces municipal bureaucracy with a real-time spatial ledger: every report, dispatch, and closeout is verified and timestamped in one shared record instead of scattered paper trails. Work is sourced to local tradespeople first (closed-loop local sourcing), the platform self-insures its own treasury against claims instead of paying a third-party underwriter, and the margin that used to go to legacy software vendors gets reinvested straight back into the cities running it.
